relations.statement: multisetArea [6] = multisetArea [1,1,1,1] = <0,4,0,0,0> (spin 3 equals four spin-1/2 punctures in area)
relations.hypotheses: punctures labelled by p=2j, simple transverse punctures

lemmas.statement: Area of one puncture with p=6 (j=3) equals area of four punctures with p=1 (j=1/2), as sums of sqrt(j(j+1)) in units l_P^2, since sqrt12=4*sqrt3/2... both equal 2 sqrt3
For k>=1 the single puncture area squared is at least 3/4, so smallest nonzero level is spin 1/2

near_misses.claim: The eq. (4.12) spectrum l_P^2 sum sqrt(j(j+1)) already includes the factor 8 pi gamma
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Footnote 6 p.16: the 8 pi gamma factor is restored separately; the stated spectrum omits it

near_misses.claim: Trivalent vertices have nonzero volume per eq. (1) and (37) of gr-qc/9411005
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Erratum Nucl. Phys. B 456 (1995) 753: trivalent vertex volume is zero
